name: Checkers
author: Henrique Barcia Lang
description: English draughts for two players on one screen: tap a piece, then tap where it goes; captures are compulsory. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: English draughts for two players on one screen: tap a piece, then tap where it goes; captures are compulsory. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Dama inglese per due giocatori sullo stesso schermo: tocca una pedina, poi dove va; le prese sono obbligatorie. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
